chronology: Prophet era -> Companions -> Followers -> Hijri chronology -> present day -> future catalog additions
provider_policy: provider-neutral catalogued-source failover; no source is privileged or mandatory
storage_policy: one physical PDF copy per book across complementary primary/secondary shards; verified objects are never deleted by catalog cleanup
quality_policy: technical quality and completeness gate before persistence; source PDF is never rewritten
rights_policy: acquisition is separate from public redistribution; rights-unknown remains protected/private
resume_policy: persistent chronological queue; every run resumes pending books and preserves per-book attempt state; queue is state, never catalog
chronology_policy: explicit Hijri chronology metadata first; author death Hijri fallback; future additions always remain after present-day material
hosted_runtime_policy: each hosted job is a resumable execution slice; automatic continuation is required and the queue never ends because of a book-count target
catalog_policy: the master catalog is materialized from preserved historical discovery waves plus future master-source additions; discovery never implies rights or PDF availability
